description: Cross-SDK fixture (SPEC-v2 §8.1). keys are freshly generated by the producing SDK (keys.json entry schema; seeds are throwaway test data). objects follow the objects.json object schema: every ML-DSA-65 component is hedged, so signature bytes are not reproducible. A verifying SDK MUST derive each public key and key_id_v2 from its seeds, and for every object decode wire_b64, re-encode it to identical bytes, derive each signable projection, transcript M, context, tr and mu, find each pinned signature in the wire object, verify every signature with the named verify context (key names resolve to this file's keys), and reproduce every digest. A receipt_bundle_binding object is verified by strict decode of wire_b64 (verification receipt) and bundle_b64 (proof bundle) and the receipt/bundle binding check. Timestamps are relative to the fixed evaluation time 1800000000.
generator: cargo run --example v2_cross_sdk_fixture (Rust SDK, crate ratify-protocol)
